name: IndicCorp v2: Large-Scale Monolingual Corpora for Indic Languages
description: IndicCorp v2 is an extensive web-crawled monolingual text corpus spanning 24 Indic languages, developed by AI4Bharat and presented at ACL 2023. Significantly expanding upon IndicCorp v1 (EMNLP 2020), version 2 contains over 20.9 billion tokens and approximately 1.1 billion sentences across 24 languages from 4 language families, providing foundational pre-training material for models such as IndicBERT v2 and IndicBART.
